page_thesis: The 2026 FIFA World Cup opens at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City on June 11, 2026, marking the start of the first 48-team World Cup across three host nations. This page provides tournament structure, qualified teams, match schedules, and viewing information for the historic event starting in 25 days.
confidence_summary: Excellent evidence from multiple official FIFA sources confirms June 11, 2026 opening at Estadio Azteca. Tournament structure and schedule available from authoritative sources. No contradictions.
